name: Recording Na⁺ and K⁺ ionic currents during an AP
description: In this example, we simulate a single neuron (me-model) and record its membrane potential (v) together with sodium (Na⁺, ina) and potassium (K⁺, ik) ionic currents. By observing these ion-level currents during an evoked action potential, we can explore how sodium influx and potassium efflux shape the waveform of the spike.
